annotations.title: Text to speech (TTS): natural voices, audio file

description: Turn up to 300 characters of text into natural, human-sounding speech: MP3 in 7 languages (English, Spanish, German, French, Dutch, Italian and Japanese; 82 voices) with Deepgram Aura-2. zh and ko are retired with MeloTTS (Workers AI, 20 Nov 2026) and are refused uncharged. Pick a voice by name or leave the default. Use for voice replies, audio notes, accessibility and phone or chat bots; for up to 2,000 characters use text_to_speech. Example: text=Your payment was received. Thank you!. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

format.description: Audio format: mp3 (default), wav, pcm (raw 16-bit little-endian mono), ulaw or alaw (8 kHz telephony, e.g. Twilio), opus (Ogg) or flac. opus and flac only for text spoken in one part (up to 450 characters)

lang.description: Language: en, es, de, fr, nl, it or ja (Aura-2 MP3, many voices); zh and ko are retired (MeloTTS was removed from Workers AI, 20 Nov 2026); default en

pronunciations.description: How to say words: JSON {"Nginx":"engine x","GIF":"jif"} or Nginx=engine x, GIF=jif (up to 50, whole words, any case)

sample_rate.description: Sample rate in Hz for wav and pcm (8000, 16000, 24000 default, 32000, 48000) or ulaw/alaw (8000 default, 16000)

text.description: Text to speak, up to 300 characters

voice.description: Voice name. English: amalthea, andromeda, apollo, arcas, aries, asteria, athena, atlas, aurora, callista, cora, cordelia, delia, draco, electra, harmonia, helena, hera, hermes, hyperion, iris, janus, juno, jupiter, luna, mars, minerva, neptune, odysseus, ophelia, orion, orpheus, pandora, phoebe, pluto, saturn, thalia, theia, vesta, zeus. Spanish: sirio, nestor, carina, celeste, alvaro, diana, aquila, selena, estrella, javier. German: julius, elara, aurelia, lara, fabian, kara, viktoria. French: agathe, hector. Dutch: rhea, beatrix, daphne, cornelia, sander, hestia, lars, roman, leda. Italian: livia, melia, elio, flavio, maia, cinzia, cesare, dionisio, demetra. Japanese: izanami, uzume, ebisu, fujin, ama. Default: luna (en), aquila (es), else the first listed
